name: classify-objects
instruction: Sort writing tools, toy vehicle and camera equipment into three bins, one complete category per bin. Any category may use any bin; do not mix categories. Return both arms to origin.
reset_instruction: Writing tools: black pen and white stylus. Toy vehicle: wooden race car. Camera equipment: action camera and two black mounts. Red, blue and green bins. All six objects begin outside bins. Record matched initial layout and neutral poses for both arms. Confirm ACT start pose, all three camera views, open empty grippers and station stop control. Reset to the identical scene between policies.
success_question: 3 complete categories, each in a distinct bin, with every category member inside, no foreign objects and grippers open. All objects settled and arms at origin. Every qualifying object must be released, settled for 2 seconds and unsupported by a gripper. Full success also requires both arms at the recorded origin.

milestones.criterion: 1 complete categories, each in a distinct bin, with every category member inside, no foreign objects and grippers open.
2 complete categories, each in a distinct bin, with every category member inside, no foreign objects and grippers open.
3 complete categories, each in a distinct bin, with every category member inside, no foreign objects and grippers open. All objects settled and arms at origin.

phases: Did it identify and acquire every member of category 1?
Did it carry all objects of category 1 over the same chosen unused bin?
Did it release all category 1 members fully inside, verify completeness and no contamination? Preserve earlier qualifying units.
Did it identify and acquire every member of category 2?
Did it carry all objects of category 2 over the same chosen unused bin?
Did it release all category 2 members fully inside, verify completeness and no contamination? Preserve earlier qualifying units.
Did it identify and acquire every member of category 3?
Did it carry all objects of category 3 over the same chosen unused bin?
Did it release all category 3 members fully inside, verify completeness and no contamination? Verify all completed units and return both arms to origin.
